data.one_liner: Add short links and deep linking to Flutter applications.
data.what_it_does: ChottuLink is a deep linking and short link solution for Flutter apps. It allows developers to generate dynamic links with custom parameters and handle incoming links when the app is launched or running.
use_when: You want to migrate from Firebase Dynamic Links to an alternative deep linking solution.
Your app needs to handle universal and deferred deep links on Android and iOS.
You need to generate branded short links directly from your Flutter app.
avoid_when: You require complex state management solutions not related to link handling.
You are targeting platforms other than Android and iOS.
strengths: Provides a drop-in replacement for Firebase Dynamic Links.
Supports both universal and deferred deep links.
Includes features for resolving short URLs and built-in analytics tracking.
weaknesses: Limited platform support (only Android and iOS are documented).
Relies on an external dashboard and API keys for link generation and management.
data.setup_notes: Requires initializing the SDK in main.dart with an API key, configuring the ChottuLink dashboard, and setting minimum versions such as iOS 15.0+ and Android minSdkVersion 21.
